name: Book Binder Training by Department for the Welfare of Differently Abled Persons
benefit: - Free book binding training every year is imparted in government higher secondary schools for the visually impaired.
_eligibility_text:
1. The beneficiary should be a visually impaired person.
1. The beneficiary should have passed the 8th standard. 
1. The beneficiary  should be between 18 to 40 years age group.
